title: 第9章 万古钟第10章 你在质疑本圣子
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: “不是吧！
我好歹也是合欢圣地的圣子啊，母亲更是堂堂圣人！
我这气运等级怎么还是负数！”
他通过之前点亮神女图给的奖励，斩运刀的使用备注中，已经知晓了人的气运等级。
从低到高分别是：黑，赤，橙，黄，绿，青，蓝，紫，七彩，共九个等级。
一般而言，普通凡人的气运都为黑色。
可以修炼的普通修士，则是赤色，而气运在绿色及以上的，才可称之为气运之子或气运之女。
像是柳如烟，便是绿色的普通气运之女，而他那个青梅竹马叶峰，更是气运极高紫色顶尖气运之子！
“看来需要多多与气运之女双修，尽快提升气运了。”
徐墨暗暗想着。
毕竟这黑色气运也太吓人了，竟然随时都有陨落的危险，这最起码也要提升到最普通的赤色才行。
看来只和柳如烟一人双修显然是不够的，气运提升得太慢。
而慕容雪虽然是除了传说中的七彩外，等级最高的紫色气运，可是现在的她根本不可能答应与他双修。
他如今可真是太难了！
徐墨叹了口气，关闭九重天眼，现在想太多也无用，还是赶紧提升实力重要！
接着他又用了两天时间，继续感悟九阳灭世诀的第一层，并成功将第一层修炼到了小成，自身修为也跟着提升了少许。
虽然不至于突破到炼虚中期，但是战力却提高了不少。
“不如去圣地广场，测试一下我如今的实力！”
徐墨如今的修为可是比之前整整提升了一个大境界。
他自然想测试一下，自己现在的实力究竟有多高！
而另一边的柳如烟。
她离开圣子殿后，并没有和昨日一样急着赶回去找叶峰。
而是一边感受着体内磅礴的气息，一边缓慢的走着。
直到现在，她还有些不敢相信，她竟然真的从元婴中期提升到了元婴后期。
要知道，按照她之前的修炼速度，想要突破到元婴后期，最起码需要两三个月甚至更久。
可如今，仅仅是和徐墨双修了两天，便直接突破到了元婴后期，而且她觉得自己距离元婴后期巅峰也不远了。
她感觉要是再和徐墨多双修几次，就能直接提升到元婴后期巅峰了。
想到这，她不由面色一红，对自己刚刚的想法感到有些羞耻，同时她也想到了之前徐墨对她说的话。
什么与他双修是她的福气……
“不过该说不说，虽然时间长了些，但是总体感觉还是挺不错的！”
柳如烟轻声地自言自语。
虽说可能是因为自己不是第一次了，再加上徐墨的经验也进步了些。
反正这一次的双修并没有昨日那般痛苦，虽然柳如烟不想承认，但是，她确实也有些小快乐！
特别是那什么之后，感觉自己像突然在天上一样！
而且和徐墨双修的时候，不仅有快乐，修为也能跟着提升，她现在竟然有些期待明天。
“如烟妹妹，你刚刚在说什么东西？
什么时间长了些？”
就在柳如烟思考时，叶峰的声音突然传入她的耳中，顿时吓了她一大跳。
柳如烟抬头望去，发现自己不知不觉，竟然已经走到了洞府门口。
而叶峰此刻，正眉头微皱地站在门口，看向她的目光中充满了疑惑。
显然疑惑柳如烟为何会那样说。
“啊？没什么啊！
叶哥哥，你刚才应该是听错了，我没说什么时间长！”
content_en:
"No!
After all, I am also the holy son of Hehuan Holy Land, and my mother is a saint!
Why is my luck level still negative! "
He already knew the person's luck level through the rewards given by lighting up the goddess picture and the instructions for using the luck-cutting knife.
From low to high they are: black, red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, indigo, purple and colorful, a total of nine levels.
Generally speaking, the luck of ordinary mortals is black.
Ordinary monks who can practice are red, and only those whose luck is green and above can be called sons or daughters of luck.
Liu Ruyan, for example, is the daughter of green ordinary luck, and his childhood sweetheart Ye Feng is the son of purple top luck with extremely high luck!
"It seems that we need to practice double cultivation with Duoduo and the Girl of Luck to improve our luck as soon as possible."
Xu Mo thought secretly.
After all, this black luck is too scary, and it is in danger of falling at any time. This must at least be upgraded to the most common red color.
It seems that just practicing dual cultivation with Liu Ruyan is obviously not enough. The improvement of luck is too slow.
Although Murong Xue has the highest level of purple luck besides the legendary Seven Colors, it is impossible for her to agree to dual cultivation with him now.
It's really hard for him now!
Xu Mo sighed and closed the Nine Heavenly Eyes. It was useless to think too much now. It was still important to improve his strength quickly!
He then spent another two days to continue to comprehend the first level of the Nine Yang Art of Destroying the World, and successfully practiced the first level to a small level, and his own cultivation level also improved a little.
Although it is not possible to break through to the middle stage of Void Refining, the combat power has been improved a lot.
"Why not go to Holy Land Square and test my current strength!"
Xu Mo's current cultivation level has improved to a much higher level than before.
He naturally wants to test how high his current strength is!
…
And Liu Ruyan on the other side.
After she left the Holy Child Hall, she was not in a hurry to go back to find Ye Feng like yesterday.
Instead, he walked slowly while feeling the majestic breath in his body.
Until now, she still can't believe that she has actually been promoted from the middle stage of Yuanying to the late stage of Yuanying.
You know, according to her previous cultivation speed, it would take at least two to three months or even longer to break through to the late Nascent Soul stage.
But now, after just two days of cultivation with Xu Mo, she had directly broken through to the late Yuanying stage, and she felt that she was not far from the peak of the late Yuanying stage.
She felt that if she practiced double cultivation with Xu Mo a few more times, she could be directly promoted to the peak of the late Nascent Soul.
Thinking of this, she couldn't help but blush, feeling a little ashamed of what she had just thought. At the same time, she also thought of what Xu Mo said to her before.
Why is it her blessing to practice dual cultivation with him...
"But should I say it, although it took a long time, the overall feeling is quite good!"
Liu Ruyan whispered to himself softly.
Although it may be because it's not his first time, and Xu Mo's experience has also improved a bit.
Anyway, the double cultivation this time was not as painful as yesterday. Although Liu Ruyan didn't want to admit it, she did have some happiness!
Especially after that, I felt like I was suddenly in heaven!
Moreover, when practicing dual cultivation with Xu Mo, not only was she happy, but her cultivation level could also be improved. She was actually looking forward to tomorrow.
"Sister Ruyan, what were you talking about just now?
What time is longer? "
Just when Liu Ruyan was thinking, Ye Feng's voice suddenly came to her ears, which shocked her.
Liu Ruyan looked up and found that she had reached the entrance of the cave without knowing it.
At this moment, Ye Feng was standing at the door with a slight frown on his face, looking at her with doubts in his eyes.
Obviously wondering why Liu Ruyan said that.
"Huh? It's nothing!
Brother Ye, you must have heard wrong just now. I didn’t say how long it took! "
